If you can’t receive the verification code on your email, learn what to do:
a) Better use popular mail providers for stable services.
b) Check your spam and junk folder.
c) Check that you have been set up with email forwarding and collection functions.

If you can’t receive the verification code, learn what to do:
a) Check whether the text is blocked by SMS filtering services.
b) Check that your SMS mailbox has sufficient space.
c) Make sure that your device has enough space to receive SMS.
d) Ensure you have a strong cell phone signal.
e) Check whether the mobile phone is turned off at the time of receiving the SMS; Restart your phone and try to resend code;
f) If your device is a dual SIM phone, check whether the two cards are put correctly. You can exchange their position and try again.
g) Try restarting your phone;
h) If you still don't receive SMS messages, contact your carrier.

string.name: explain_cdx
string.Data: ‘cdx’ is a ChemDraw-specific format that is compatible with Chemdraw, but some of the King files will be lost. Click on the format description to view the details.

string.name: explain_jpg
string.Data: ‘jpg’ format uses lossy compression which means that taking up space as less as possible. Default background color is white. You can save drawing elements as ‘jpg’ format to system album.

string.name: explain_kdx
string.Data: ‘kdx’is a brand new format file of KingDraw, which can replace and overwrite the King file. It can meet more drawing requirements and store larger content. Click on the format description to view the details.

string.name: explain_mol
string.Data: The ‘mol’ file format is stored in the MDL Molfile standard protocol V2000 protocol and is compatible with other mainstream editors. However, the King file will be partially lost. Click on the format description to view the details.

string.name: explain_mol_v3000
string.Data: The ‘mol v3000’ file format is stored in the MDL Molfile V3000 protocol and is compatible with other major editors. However, some of the King files will be lost. Click on the format description to view the details.

string.name: explain_png
string.Data: ‘png’ means Portable Network Graphic format, which is a lossless image compression of bitmap graphic format and can fully recover the original data without causing any distortion. The drawing elements can be saved as ‘png’ format to systematic album.
